The following events took place in '''37 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*Young liberals claim control of [[Pergitor]] in a revolution, displacing the authoritarian leadership of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="HNN Pergitor">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|46|regional/1337_4.html|Pergitor Coup Leaves Thousands Dead}}</ref>
*[[Vagaari/Legends|Vagaari]] begin moving through the region of [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] space around [[Crustai system/Legends|Crustai system]]. {{C|Latest possible date}}<ref name="Outbound Flight">[[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']]</ref>
*[[Watto/Legends|Watto]] buys [[Shmi Skywalker Lars/Legends|Shmi Skywalker Lars]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] to be his slaves
*The [[Yam'rii/Legends|Yam'rii]] are enslaved.

==Behind the scenes==
According to the character [[Till]] appearing in the introduction of the game ''[[Star Wars: Rebel Assault II: The Hidden Empire]]'', the [[Battle of Dreighton]] happened that year ("forty years ago"). ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' established that the battle happened in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].
